items.expected: Return unsupported aggregate without discarding raw observations or showing a rounded total.
items.current: Safe whole-silver pre-multiply/pre-add guard shared by loadout and build-cost API; knownCost null and explicit UI range state.
items.historical_files: See current review ledgers and source paths.
items.verification: Independent arithmetic helper, API and UI regression;11 focused tests passed before final phase.

items.title: Detail gear price link misses minimum touch target
items.reproduction: Open an account build with one main hand at375px and run target-size checks.
items.expected: The selected gear comparison link is at least24px high.
items.current: The price link now has a32px minimum target height.
items.historical_cause: The redesigned compact row used text line height only (18.6px).
items.verification: Initial detail full phase112/113 failed; final293unit/113browser gate passes after the32px correction.

items.title: Account browser history can silently discard an unsaved build
items.reproduction: Create/save a build, open Edit, immediately change its title, then browser Back/Forward.
items.expected: The unsaved title and original revision token survive SPA navigation.
items.current: Account controls wait for recovery readiness; committed memory snapshots and lease-checked unmount recovery retain the draft without browser storage.
items.historical_cause: The first-frame deferred readiness skipped the passive memory writer, especially after create/save navigation.
items.verification: Exact production failure reproduced; unchanged immediate history, conflict and logout assertions pass in the final334unit/118browser phase.

items.title: Composition member dialog siblings reuse one React key
items.reproduction: Open an initialized composition member and change its notes or copied equipment.
items.expected: Spare sets and equipment controls retain distinct component identities.
items.current: Sibling keys are independently prefixed for sets and equipment.
items.historical_cause: Both sibling components used selected.id as the same key.
items.verification: Browser copy/notes journey asserts no duplicate-key console errors and validates exact bounded notes after copy.

items.title: Immediate guest browser history can cancel the autosave debounce
items.reproduction: Edit a valid guest title and immediately navigate Back before700ms.
items.expected: The valid latest draft survives; invalid intermediate input does not replace the last valid stored draft.
items.current: A guest-only unmount flush validates the latest committed draft after restoration readiness.
items.historical_cause: SPA unmount cleared the debounce timer before it persisted the latest edit.
items.verification: Existing guest browser journey now verifies immediate Back/Forward and invalid-draft preservation in the final production phase.

items.title: Favorite build collection uses an invalid unnamed generic role
items.reproduction: Open account Favorites and run the page accessibility checks.
items.expected: A labelled collection has a valid role.
items.current: Favorite player builds now have a labelled group role.
items.historical_cause: The new account grid had aria-label on a generic div.
items.verification: Initial phase116/118 exposed the violation; final334unit/118browser phase and full responsive page audit pass.

items.title: Editor mobile tabs and picker inherit incorrect scroll and surface styling
items.reproduction: Scroll from the mobile equipment board to Alternatives or open the picker.
items.expected: Tabs sit at the viewport top after the header scrolls away; the picker fills the viewport with aligned labels.
items.current: Tabs use top0, inspector margin64; the drawer resets native sizing and clip animation and aligns heading/row text.
items.historical_cause: Tab offsets assumed a sticky header and global surface animation/heading/text rules overrode drawer intent.
items.verification: Final rebuilt-production390/1440 captures, actual geometry, sampled axe and responsive browser assertions pass; defective captures are retained.

items.title: Discovery callback transactions fail across the Cloudflare web RPC boundary
items.reproduction: Open account discovery or favorites in the native Cloudflare application runtime.
items.expected: Count and page rows execute atomically inside the approved private database service.
items.current: Validated named discovery/favorites services execute complete count/row queries inside the approved private DO transaction. Node keeps RepeatableRead; stored JSON and Date values are preserved.
items.historical_cause: Node callback transactions worked locally; the web RPC driver correctly rejected interactive callbacks, which had not been exercised by raw native-query parity.
items.verification: The initial native web suite107/118 failed. After the service-boundary correction335 Node units,118 Node browser cases,20 native database cases and the complete118-case Cloudflare browser suite pass. The web transaction guard remains unchanged.

items.title: Guest source-copy reload discards edits and overwrites the saved draft
items.reproduction: An anonymous visitor copies Battleaxe Mist Build, edits its title, waits for device autosave, then reloads the same from=source URL.
items.expected: The validated edited source-copy draft restores; plain-new and other source/region drafts remain independent.
items.current: Guest source copies restore validated draft state before controls become editable, using source/region-scoped device records. Plain-new retains its legacy key; protected invalid records require explicit successful Save to replace.
items.historical_cause: Source initial data bypassed guest restoration while still autosaving into the shared plain-new key.
items.verification: Actual original anonymous public reset/overwrite retained. Final Node22 phase passes339 units/118 production browser cases/15 disposable PostgreSQL checks/nine regional reads and all ten gates; complete rebuilt Cloudflare web118/118 passes. Source-copy title/equipment/abilities reload, immediate navigation, source/region/context isolation, corrupt preservation and explicit replacement pass. Initial new Node115/118 failures remain: two stale shared-key assumptions and a history-navigation synchronization omission were corrected with destination/source URL plus record assertions; original gear/spell/strategy assertions remain. Publication/read-back is recorded separately.
